name: Omaservarr
author: sette7blo
description: Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr in the Omarchy bar. The icon counts active downloads and changes its colour when a service is down. One panel, five tabs: the queue with progress and why a download is stuck, upcoming releases by day, recent imports, the library with what is missing, and each service's health checks. It only reads; a command line tool, a launcher and optional agent skills come with it, and the skills add a title only after you confirm.

barWidget.description: Download count and health for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr, with a panel for the queue, upcoming releases, recent imports and the library.
